title: bddo:vaxD and bddo:vaxG read the same eight bytes as different numbers
description: 80 40 then six zero bytes is the word 0x4080 first. As D_floating: exponent 129 (eight bits), fraction 0, so 0.5 x 2 = 1.0. As G_floating: exponent 0x408 = 1032 (eleven bits), fraction 0, so 0.5 x 2^8 = 128.0. 20 C1 ... is D_floating -2.5 (exponent 130, fraction 2^53 of 2^56) and 24 C0 ... G_floating -2.5 (exponent 1026, fraction 2^50 of 2^53).
